newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht dips late on finance firm suspensions.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht dips late on finance firm suspensions.

text.p: The Thai baht was down against the dollar late on Tuesday as players shifted to the safer U.S. unit after Thailand's unexpected announcement it would suspend another 42 troubled finance companies, dealers said.

"The market had expected only the International Monetary Fund's rescue package. The suspension of a large number of finance companies was unexpected and triggered some dollar buying," said one dealer at foreign bank.
The baht fell to 31.70/32.00 to the dollar near the close in domestic market from 31.20/31.40 in early trade.
